timing: Concat durations from differences between measured elapsedSeconds; final duration from recorded span minus final elapsedSeconds. Variable frame timestamps; container time-base quantization applies.
geometry: Only pad odd width/height to even dimensions for yuv420p; no motion interpolation.
limitation: Two transition starts; third update cancels the still-active previous animation under synchronous capture load. Original motionChecksPassed=false is preserved. No FPS or 180 ms wall-time acceptance claim.
verificationSource: Encoding and ffprobe verified by verification_release agent; exact encoding script retained as motion-encoding-source.txt.
